info.title: mashov2go API
info.description: Admin REST API. Browser sessions use the m2g_session cookie and send the CSRF token in X-CSRF-Token on state-changing requests. Scripts use Bearer API tokens with read or admin scope. Errors are RFC 7807 problem documents. Bootstrap: the first admin password is set by POST /api/v1/setup, or from MASHOV2GO_ADMIN_PASSWORD.
